purpose: numerical-convergence and deterministic atomic-structure sensitivity audit of the stored final-reference-reoptimized pulse

fixed_inputs.pulse_provenance: selected by simulations/optimize_forster_p0_4_reference.py on the final P0-4 numerical-reference model
fixed_inputs.reoptimization_status: deterministic accepted local candidate; 400-iteration / 625-evaluation budget exhausted; not a converged or global optimum

interaction_order_scope.order_4: cumulative through R^-4: dipole-dipole plus dipole-quadrupole and quadrupole-dipole
interaction_order_scope.order_5: partial R^-5 sensitivity: adds quadrupole-quadrupole but the PairInteraction implementation does not include dipole-octupole or octupole-dipole
interaction_order_scope.source: PairInteraction SystemPair.cpp setInteractionOrder and getInteraction implementation

reference_model_bounded_validation.pulse_reoptimization_provenance: simulations/optimize_forster_p0_4_reference.py; deterministic accepted local candidate after 400 iterations / 625 evaluations on this final P0-4 reference model; optimizer budget exhausted, not converged/global

source.citation: Peper et al., Phys. Rev. X 15, 011009 (2025)
source.parameter_covariance: no covariance matrix is reported in the article or its tabulated supplement

spectroscopy_sensitivity_envelope.interpretation: four signed deterministic vertices used as a sensitivity envelope, not independent standard deviations, a confidence interval, or a refit of the PairInteraction v1.4 database
spectroscopy_sensitivity_envelope.model_scope: shifts only the addressed Yb SS and PP energies; coupling matrix elements, wave functions, all other levels, and Rb structure remain fixed

pure_target_pair_defect_scan.definition: offset added to E_SS-E_PP by lowering the target-PP projector; fixed pulse with no wave-function or coupling changes

axial_dc_electric_field_scan.field_direction: parallel to quantization and internuclear axes
axial_dc_electric_field_scan.experimental_stability_context: Peper et al. report day-to-day compensation variation below 0.003 V/cm; this is context, not a distribution
axial_dc_electric_field_scan.fixed_laser_scope: includes isolated Rb 56S and Yb SS carrier shifts relative to zero field; ground/metastable-state Stark shifts are omitted
axial_dc_electric_field_scan.limitations: axial fields only; no transverse-field scan or covariance; large-field rows are stress tests rather than a converged laboratory robustness guarantee

control_decay_recheck_provenance.decay_convention: radiative no-jump including Rb56S control-excited target state
